messages:
maria (Partnerships): Quick sync — finalizing the Summit joint session with AtlasEdge next Wed 11:00am PT. Need run-of-show, speaker queue, remote demo hotseat plan, A/V checklist, and swag pickup cutoff. tagging @sophie for partner confirmations

ajay (Solutions): Can do. suggest 4 segments: intro (5m), keynote panel (25m), demo hotseat (20m), Q&A (10m). total 60m incl buffer.

kevin (DevRel): +1. For demo hotseat we should pre-record fallbacks and have 2 live slots + 2 pre-recorded standby demos. keep live demos to 6–8 mins each.

sophie (AtlasEdge): Confirmed on our side. Speakers: me (product), nikhil (edge infra), and i can spare a senior eng for live demo. We can bring a loaner devkit for stage.

jordan (Events): Room A tech: HDMI + 2x XLR + captive wifi. AV will provide 1 on-site laptop (Windows) and a video capture unit. Please submit speaker slides 48h before. Swag pickup at booth B from 9:30am. Shipping cutoff to venue: Fri EOD.

maria (Partnerships): Awesome. Who owns the run-of-show PDF and speaker cue cards? I can draft but need someone to double-check timing.

ajay (Solutions): I’ll draft the run-of-show and speaker cues. Kevin can own the demo failover runbook and pre-recorded checklist.

kevin (DevRel): I’ll create a short failover playbook and a test script. Putting the test script here so we can run CI demo checks:

```bash
# demo smoke test (use demo account creds in vault)
curl -sS -X POST https://demo.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEMO_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-serve-lite","input":"summit demo smoke test"}'
```

kevin (DevRel): If that returns under 400ms for sample tokens we mark it green. I’ll add a step to record a 3m video of the live demo as a fallback.

sophie (AtlasEdge): Shipping note: our logistics needs the booth address + contact for customs form. Jordan can you DM the address? Also we’ll pack 150 mini swag kits (stickers + charger). Any constraints on booth space for storage?

jordan (Events): DM sent. Booth storage is limited — recommend shipping kits to the hotel receiving desk for same-day transfer. Label with "AtlasEdge / Redwood - Booth B". Hotel receiving cutoff is Mon 5pm.

maria (Partnerships): Swag plan: Redwood will provide 200 plush stickers + 100 tee shirts. Proposal: AtlasEdge gives mini chargers; we do co-branded sleeves. Any objections?

ajay (Solutions): No objections. Can we do a small raffle during Q&A to drive booth visits? Simple prize: 1x AtlasEdge devkit + Redwood credits.

sophie (AtlasEdge): love the raffle idea. we’ll provide the devkit. how do we collect entries?

kevin (DevRel): easiest: digital form + QR on slide (link to booth capture page). DevRel can stand by to demo to raffle winner for 10–15m post-event.

maria (Partnerships): Ok action items so far:
- Ajay: run-of-show draft by Fri 11am PT (ASSIGNED)
- Kevin: demo failover runbook + smoke test + 3m fallback recording by Mon EOD (ASSIGNED)
- Sophie: confirm customs paperwork + ship swag by Mon 5pm to hotel (PARTNER)
- Jordan: confirm booth storage and AV booking, DM address (ASSIGNED)
- Maria: speaker cue cards + raffle landing page copy (ASSIGNED)

jordan (Events): AV note — please label any special adapters. We can’t guarantee dongles. bring an HDMI/USB-C adapter.

kevin (DevRel): One more: remote presenters — can you all run a 15m dress rehearsal (video + audio) 2 days before? I’ll set a Zoom and a recording.

sophie (AtlasEdge): Yes, 2 days before works. Can we do a 30min slot for slide timing and mics?

maria (Partnerships): Let's lock rehearsal: Mon 9:30am PT. Kevin please invite and drop rehearsal checklist.

eventbot: Reminder scheduled: "Summit - AtlasEdge rehearsal" Mon 09:30am PT (added by kevin)

ajay (Solutions): Also tagging legal — need partner logo approval for slides. @maria will you run that?

maria (Partnerships): Yup, I’ll loop in legal after Ajay drops the PDF. Deadline for logos: Tue noon.

kevin (DevRel): Putting file names + quick checklist for recording uploads:
- prerecorded_fallback_sophie.mp4
- prerecorded_fallback_nikhil.mp4
- live_demo_recording_candidate.mp4
Upload to the shared folder and add a short note on steps to trigger fallback.

sophie (AtlasEdge): Will do. thanks everyone — looks like we have clear owners. ping me if anything changes with hardware shipping. :thumbsup:

maria (Partnerships): Great work. I’ll post the run-of-show link here when Ajay uploads. Closing thread for now, will update as items are completed. :sparkles:
